name: DingTalk
description: Connect DingTalk workspaces and handle collaboration or business data within explicit permission and confirmation boundaries.
authorization.title: Authorize a DingTalk account
authorization.description: Sign in with the DingTalk application configured by your organization. OAuth access and DingTalk PAT permissions are separate; an administrator must grant missing business permissions in DingTalk.
capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.office.title: Workplace collaboration
capabilities.office.description: Work with calendars, tasks, documents, drive, mail, minutes, chat, and contacts.
capabilities.collaboration.title: Business applications
capabilities.collaboration.description: Work with AI tables, spreadsheets, approvals, attendance, recruiting, reports, and other DingTalk data.
capabilities.safety.title: Action confirmation
capabilities.safety.description: Ordinary writes follow the DingTalk command policy. Confirmation-required writes and every destructive action show exact arguments and require one-time approval.
configuration.appKey.label: AppKey
configuration.appKey.description: The Client ID (AppKey) of your DingTalk Open Platform application.
configuration.appSecret.label: AppSecret
configuration.appSecret.description: The Client Secret (AppSecret) of your DingTalk Open Platform application.
